module: Loader of the "driveline" file recorded during a rally recce. A driveline is a sequence of timestamped points (position, orientation) of the driven route. The module reads the mission's JSONL file and builds a PointList with relationships between points and normals. Extension gameplay_rally_recce_drivelineRecording, used by the recce class.
notes: Each JSONL line must contain pos (vec3), quat and ts (timestamp); they are passed to PointList():createPoint.
At least 3 points are required, otherwise loading fails (E log, nil return).

load.desc: Loads the mission's driveline file and returns a ready-to-use PointList (setupPointRelationships and setupPointNormals already called).

missionDir.desc: Mission folder containing the driveline file (rallyUtil.drivelineFile)

returns.desc: PointList, or nil if the file is absent, unreadable or has fewer than 3 points
